schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.content: Build your service run sheet here. Add verses, media, slides, and YouTube items, then reorder to match your flow.

transcript.title: Live Transcript
transcript.content: Start transcribing to convert speech to text in real time. Detected Bible verses are highlighted automatically.

detections.title: AI Detections
detections.content: Detected verses appear here. Press Present to display a verse on screen, or Queue to save it for later.

aiVerses.title: AI Verses
aiVerses.content: Detected verses with high confidence automatically land here. Review, reorder, and present them during your service.

quickTabs.title: Quick Tabs
quickTabs.content: Quickly switch between Verse, Media, and Slide items for easy drag-and-drop into your schedule list.

bookSearch.title: Book Search
bookSearch.content: Look up any verse by book, chapter, and number. Switch translations from the dropdown.

contextSearch.title: Context Search
contextSearch.content: Search by phrase or topic. LumenLive uses AI to find matching verses.

quickNav.title: Quick Navigation
quickNav.content: Type to instantly navigate: 'J' → 'Joshua' or '1 J' → '1 John', press Tab to advance stages, then type chapter and verse.

preview.title: Programme Preview
preview.content: Preview how your schedule items will look before going live. What you see here is what your audience sees.

liveDisplay.title: Live Display
liveDisplay.content: The live output. Presented verses appear here and on connected displays or NDI outputs.

views.title: Views
views.content: Switch between Slides, Media, and YouTube tabs to manage other content types alongside your live service.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.content: Configure NDI output, display windows, and resolution for your production setup.

theme.title: Theme Designer
theme.content: Design how your broadcast looks — fonts, colours, backgrounds, and layouts for verses on screen.

settings.title: Settings
settings.content: Configure audio input, Bible translations, display mode, remote control, and API keys.
